system.description: These wickedly sharp throwing stars are coated with a deadly poison and made with an infusion of warpstone. Damage Rating: 4 Critical Rating: 3 Range: Close Group: Thrown Qualities: Thrown, Pierce 1 Encumbrance: 1 Each star counts as a minor source of corruption. When the attacker inflicts a critical wound with a Warpstone Throwing Star, the target suffers fatigue equal to the severity of the critical wound.
